name: Terminal Plugin
description: PTY terminal emulator using xterm.js with FitAddon. Creates a terminal instance in a card body, wires IPC to main-process node-pty via terminal:create/write/resize/kill channels. Handles Ctrl+Shift+C for copy selection and Ctrl+Shift+V for paste (write to PTY only to avoid echo double-paste). Reads theme colors from CSS custom properties for terminal background/foreground/cursor. Provides getScreenBuffer() for AI agent access to terminal output.

properties.name: uuid
properties.description: PTY process UUID matching main process terminal map

properties.name: element
properties.description: Container element for the xterm terminal

properties.name: onExit
properties.description: Callback invoked when the PTY process exits

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Creates xterm Terminal with FitAddon, attaches IPC listeners for data/exit, observes resize

methods.name: static readTheme
methods.signature: (): { background: string; foreground: string; cursor: string; selectionBackground: string }
methods.description: Reads --bg, --primary, --accent CSS vars for terminal theme

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Applies current CSS theme colors to the xterm instance

methods.name: getScreenBuffer
methods.description: Returns the last N lines of terminal output as plain text

methods.name: fit
methods.description: Adjusts terminal cols/rows to match container size

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Kills PTY, detaches IPC listeners, disposes xterm and ResizeObserver
